question: Which team won the Santosh Trophy 2024-25 by defeating Kerala in the final?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **West Bengal won the Santosh Trophy** for the 33rd time, defeating Kerala 1-0 in the final at Gachibowli Stadium, Hyderabad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Robi Hansda scored the only goal** in added time of the second half, capitalizing on Aditya Thapa's header into the box.
 
• Hansda finished as the tournament’s **top scorer with 12 goals**.
 
• The match saw intense competition, with Bengal narrowly missing free kicks in the 58th and 62nd minutes, while Kerala's late free kick went over the crossbar.
 
• Both teams had impressive campaigns, winning nine of their 10 matches and drawing one, showcasing their dominance.
 
• Despite Bengal's historical dominance, **Kerala had beaten Bengal in the finals of the 2017-18 and 2021-22 tournaments**.
